newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BETIS STRIKER ALFONSO TO PLAY AGAINST REAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BETIS STRIKER ALFONSO TO PLAY AGAINST REAL.

text.p: Real Betis striker Alfonso Perez will be able to play in this Saturday's vital top-of-the-table clash with Real Madrid after winning an appeal to overturn a yellow card picked up last week.
The Spanish international had faced automatic suspension after receiving his fifth booking of the season for hand-ball in the 3-1 victory over Extremadura.
